newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-No interest in Woolworths plan-Retail.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-No interest in Woolworths plan-Retail.

text.p: Retail Services Ltd said on Monday it has no intention of intention of changing its current wholesaling arrangements with food wholesaler David Ltd after Woolworths Ltd food wholesale expansion plan.

Retail Services, which organises the buying of groceries on behalf of more than 450 supermarkets under banners including Four Square, Nightowl, Cut Price, Buy-Rite, 7-2-7 and Thrifty T, has a long-term contract for supply from Davids.
"RSL's grocery operation will not deal with Woolworths or any other chain under the current arrangements," Retail Services (RSL) managing director John Berry said in a statement.
